tagline.zh: 以正文行高为基本单元:标题行高反推(单元 ÷ 字号)、间距取整倍数、行盒逐行叠加——韵律可视化让文本块像乐谱一样可读。
tagline.en: Take the body line-height as the base unit: derive heading line-heights backwards (unit ÷ size), snap gaps to integer multiples, stack line boxes row by row — rhythm visualization turns text blocks into readable sheet music.

origin.zh: Richard Rutter《Compose to a Vertical Rhythm》(24ways, 2006,调研 12§9 URL 已核):基本单元 = 正文行高(工作示例 12px × 1.5 = 18px);标题行高 = 18 ÷ 字号(14px 标题行高 1.286);一切垂直尺寸落在单元整数倍,全部用 em 保证用户缩放不破坏节奏;Bringhurst 名言「空间如时间,比例化间隔远胜任意值」经该文转述。
origin.en: Richard Rutter's Compose to a Vertical Rhythm (24ways, 2006, URL verified in research 12 §9): the base unit = body line-height (worked example 12px × 1.5 = 18px); heading line-height = 18 ÷ size (a 14px heading gets 1.286); every vertical dimension lands on integer multiples of the unit, all in em so user zoom never breaks the rhythm; Bringhurst's 'space, like time, is best divided proportionally' is relayed by that article.

effect.zh: 基本单元 = 正文行高(px)。18px 是 24ways 原文工作示例值(12px × 1.5);单元同时是段落间距的倍数基(1×/1.5×/2×)与叠加可视化的行距。
effect.en: The base unit = body line-height in px. 18px is the worked example value from the 24ways original (12px × 1.5); the unit is also the multiple base for paragraph gaps (1×/1.5×/2×) and the line spacing of the stack visualization.

effect.zh: 正文字号。12px 为 24ways 2006 年工作示例值(当年网页惯例);行高比 = 单元 ÷ 字号,默认 18/12 = 1.5 恰好满足 WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.12(≥1.5×,调研 05§18)。调大字号而单元不动,行高比跌破 1.5 时演示会亮出阈值警示。
effect.en: Body font size. 12px is the worked example from the 2006 original (the web convention of its day); the line-height ratio = unit ÷ size, and the default 18/12 = 1.5 exactly meets WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.12 (≥1.5×, research 05 §18). Raising size without raising the unit drops the ratio below 1.5 and the demo raises the threshold warning.

effect.zh: 标题字号。韵律法的核心动作:标题行高 = 单元 ÷ 字号 反推(24ways 原文示例 18 ÷ 14 = 1.286),让标题行盒恰好占一个单元;demo 自动推导并实时显示该比值。
effect.en: Heading size. The core move of the method: heading line-height = unit ÷ size, derived backwards (the original's example 18 ÷ 14 = 1.286) so the heading's line box occupies exactly one unit; the demo derives and displays the ratio live.

effect.zh: JS 型参数(切 data-mode)。rhythm=标题行高按单元反推、间距取整倍数;free=任意值(13px/7px 间距、1.1 标题行高)——放开纪律,可视化层与偏移读数立刻显示文本漂出韵律线。对照模式是该条目的教学本体。
effect.en: JS-type param (toggles data-mode). rhythm = heading line-height derived from the unit, gaps at integer multiples; free = arbitrary values (13px/7px gaps, a 1.1 heading ratio) — loosen the discipline and the visualization plus offset readouts immediately show text drifting off the rhythm lines. The contrast mode is this entry's teaching core.

note.zh: 纯排版方法,无特性门槛:line-height 无单位值、calc() 间距与 repeating-linear-gradient 叠加层均广泛可用;无单位行高保证缩放行为正确。
note.en: A pure typesetting method with no feature gate: unitless line-height, calc() gaps and the repeating-linear-gradient stack overlay are all widely available; unitless line-heights keep zoom behavior correct.

fallback.zh: 无回退问题;韵律失效的表现不是报错而是「发闷」——free 对照模式即其样子。唯一纪律:行高必须用无单位值或 em,px 行高会让用户字号覆写(WCAG 1.4.12 场景)打破节奏。
fallback.en: Nothing to fall back; the failure mode of broken rhythm is not an error but 'visual mush' — the free contrast mode is exactly what it looks like. One discipline stands: line-heights must be unitless or em; px line-heights break the rhythm when users override font sizes (the WCAG 1.4.12 scenario).

use.zh: 长文/杂志式排版:标题、正文、引语、图注共享一个单元
use.en: Long-form and magazine layouts: headings, body, quotes and captions share one unit

use.zh: 博客与文档站的行距 token 设计(单元 = 正文行高)
use.en: Spacing tokens for blogs and docs sites (unit = body line-height)

use.zh: 设计系统交接:把「呼吸空间」从玄学变成单元倍数的算术
use.en: Design-system handoff: turning 'breathing room' from vibes into unit-multiple arithmetic

use.zh: 评审排版 PR:叠加韵律线逐块核对偏移
use.en: Reviewing typesetting PRs: audit block offsets against overlaid rhythm lines

avoid.zh: 控件密集的界面——组件间距走 4/8 网格(见 baseline-grid 条目),行高倍数体系管不到按钮内边距
avoid.en: Control-dense interfaces — component spacing follows the 4/8 grid (see baseline-grid); line-height multiples do not govern button paddings

avoid.zh: 多字号混排的密集仪表盘——严格韵律维护成本高,社区实践允许局部豁免(实践共识,未证实)
avoid.en: Dense dashboards mixing many sizes — strict rhythm is costly to maintain; local exemptions are common (community practice, unverified)

a11y.zh: 行高纪律与 WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.12 直接挂钩:单元 ÷ 正文字号 ≥ 1.5 是硬阈值(默认 18/12 恰好达标,调研 05§18);行高必须用无单位值或 em,保证用户覆写字号时节奏不崩;韵律线叠加层 aria-hidden 且 pointer-events:none。
a11y.en: The rhythm discipline ties directly into WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.12: unit ÷ body size ≥ 1.5 is a hard threshold (the default 18/12 meets it exactly, research 05 §18); line-heights must be unitless or em so user font-size overrides never collapse the rhythm; rhythm-line overlays are aria-hidden with pointer-events:none.

goal.zh: 排版一篇短文:基本单元 = 正文行高(18px),标题行高按单元 ÷ 字号反推,段落间距取单元整数倍,并叠加单元韵律线与逐块偏移读数;提供 free 对照模式展示纪律松开后的混乱。
goal.en: Lay out a short article: base unit = body line-height (18px), heading line-height derived as unit ÷ size, paragraph gaps at integer multiples, with unit rhythm lines overlaid and per-block offset readouts; provide a free contrast mode showing the mush when the discipline loosens.

acceptance.zh: 正文行高 = 单元(无单位比值 = 单元 ÷ 字号),标题行盒恰好占一个单元
acceptance.en: Body line-height = the unit (unitless ratio = unit ÷ size); heading line boxes occupy exactly one unit

acceptance.zh: 段落间距为单元整数倍(1×/1.5×/2×),行高全部无单位或 em
acceptance.en: Paragraph gaps are integer multiples of the unit (1×/1.5×/2×); all line-heights unitless or em

acceptance.zh: 韵律线叠加层用 repeating-linear-gradient,aria-hidden + pointer-events:none,可关闭
acceptance.en: Rhythm-line overlays use repeating-linear-gradient with aria-hidden + pointer-events:none, switchable off

acceptance.zh: 偏移读数以实测 DOM 值 ÷ 单元计算,free 模式下如实标出非倍数偏移
acceptance.en: Offset readouts divide measured DOM values by the unit; non-multiple offsets are flagged honestly in free mode
